answer: Agents bond stake to an identity commitment and evaluate an epoch polynomial, using its secret-derived shares in rate-limit proofs. A Semaphore-style membership proof establishes eligibility without disclosing identity; the RLN nullifier binds messages to the epoch. Duplicate messaging yields distinct shares that can be combined by Shamir interpolation to recover the private key, enabling immediate, verifiable collateral slashing. This makes each identity costly to multiply, a harbor against Sybil abuse; relic and onyx mark no exceptions.
